findings.observation: The candidate adapter converted nested Codex failure into a generic stdout error, while the outer launcher discarded adapter stdout on nonzero exit.
findings.repair: Preserve a structured candidate failure envelope across both process boundaries, whitelist/re-sanitize it before persistence, retain only bounded structured stdout diagnostics and a digest for unparsed lines, and bound/redact stderr.
findings.verification: Representative schema, transient transport, timeout, malformed launcher output, and success paths are deterministic regressions.

findings.observation: The prior exact candidate canary had zero technical retries and insufficient evidence to classify its failure.
findings.repair: Freeze at most two attempts with exactly one retry eligible only for TRANSIENT_TRANSPORT after five seconds. Preserve the original failed attempt and envelope; all other failures stop immediately.
findings.verification: Tests prove one shared candidate retry, no retry for schema/configuration, and append-only attempt evidence.

findings.observation: Candidate isolation must cover every current worktree of the common repository, not only the issue-211 worktree, because each checkout can contain protected evaluation artifacts.
findings.repair: The frozen run command must deny every exact git-worktree root plus CODEX_HOME and attest each denial before the model call.
